name: TweetClaw

repo.name: tweetclaw
repo.description: OpenClaw plugin to search tweets, search replies, post tweets, export followers, manage media, monitor X/Twitter, and run giveaway draws via Xquik.

node_fit.hypothesis: TweetClaw can power Action node runs that need public X/Twitter evidence, media workflows, monitoring, webhooks, giveaway draws, and reviewed account actions through an OpenClaw plugin boundary.
TweetClaw can collect public tweet, reply, user, follower, media, and monitor evidence for downstream Radar and Evidence Normalize nodes.
TweetClaw's OpenClaw workflow can help separate read-only evidence collection from explicit approval before write-like social actions.

evidence.note: Repository metadata shows an active MIT-licensed OpenClaw plugin with X/Twitter automation, data extraction, MCP, and ClawHub topics.
npm registry metadata exposes the scoped package and OpenClaw install metadata for the published plugin.
ClawHub lists the plugin distribution surface, but version freshness should be rechecked before approval.

risks: Requires network access and an Xquik API key for account-backed workflows.
Write-like actions such as posting, replies, direct messages, follows, media upload, webhooks, and giveaway draws must stay behind explicit operator approval.
Published npm latest and local source versions can diverge, so install examples need registry verification before use.
Public social data collection still needs platform-policy and privacy review for each deployment context.
next_review_tasks: Review TweetClaw README, packaged skill, OpenClaw manifest, and npm package artifact before moving beyond metadata_triaged.
Run a minimal OpenClaw install and inspect flow with the published npm version.
Create a fixture that separates read-only public X/Twitter evidence from approval-gated account actions.
Compare TweetClaw against browser-only and direct API approaches for Action, Radar, and Check node workloads.
